It works when run directly. So the test harness's mutation is different — in `mutate` I do `obj.pop('mode')` then only set obj['mode'] if 'mode' in kw... and `with_pkts` calls `mutate(base, packets=pkts)` which does NOT pass mode → obj has no 'mode' key → invalid! Right, that's my test harness bug: mutate removes mode and only re-adds if given.

Fix: in mutate, always restore mode unless explicitly deleted.

"""    obj.pop('mode')
    v = kw.pop('mode', base['mode'])

        obj['mode'] = v""")
